items.explanation: A general truth takes the zero conditional: if + present, present.

items.prompt: If I ___ rich, I would travel the world.
items.explanation: Hypothetical present — the second conditional uses 'were' for all persons.

items.prompt: If she had studied harder, she ___ the exam.
items.explanation: A past hypothetical — the third conditional uses 'would have + past participle'.

items.prompt: Complete with the correct verb form: I wish I ___ (buy) that jacket — now it's sold out.
items.explanation: A regret about the past takes 'wish + past perfect'.

items.prompt: Rewrite as a second conditional: "I don't have a car, so I take the bus."
answers: If I had a car, I wouldn't take the bus
If I had a car, I would not take the bus
items.explanation: Present unreal situation: if + past simple, would + base form.

items.prompt: Rewrite as a third conditional: "He didn't call, so I didn't know."
answers: If he had called, I would have known
If he had called, I would've known
items.explanation: Past unreal situation: if + past perfect, would have + past participle.
